title: 第二十章 五阵镇桃源 骄阳护花颜第二十一章 芳土辞旧意 倾心诉衷肠
content_zh:
桃源万古清宁地，一朝尽覆魔罗烟。
自第三枚时序玉璧残璧圆满归位、人间烟火道韵补全天道三成根基，三界正道气运升腾鼎盛，魔主忌惮日深，终是不惜损耗魔界本源、撕裂万古虚空结界，亲遣麾下绝顶战力，催动滔天魔劫，压境桃源。
漫天墨色魔云自九天之外倾覆而下，层层叠叠、滚滚沉沉，遮蔽桃源万里晴空，吞没所有温柔天光。方才落英纷飞、清风缱绻、湖光澄澈的世外净土，瞬息被森寒寂灭之气彻底笼罩。
风止、花寂、水凝、云死。
整片秘境，一瞬从人间仙庭，化作修罗杀场。
魔云深处，雷鸣滚滚、魔焰灼灼、煞气滔天，亿万魔兵列阵虚空，铁甲森森、魔戈映黑芒、战气锁长空。黑压压的魔军层层排布，无边无际，如潮水覆天，将整座秘境死死围困，水泄不通、遁路全无。
一股凌驾诸魔之上、远超裂岳魔帅、幽诡魔君的恐怖魔威，自魔云最深处缓缓苏醒、徐徐铺开。
沉、寂、荒、古、霸、煞、灭！
七字魔韵压落四野，震得桃源地脉震颤、灵泉倒流、桃林瑟瑟、结界嗡鸣。
何年双目骤凝，时序大道极速运转，天篆道纹覆满周身，神色凝重至极致：“是血狱魔帝！魔主座下四大魔帝之首，执掌血狱杀伐、万古寂灭，乃是魔界仅次于魔主的绝顶存在！”
一语落地，四人心神皆震。
此前历经魔帅、魔君，皆为魔界中层战力，虽凶险万分，尚可合力抗衡。而今魔帝亲至，乃是魔界顶层杀伐力量，征战万古、屠仙无数、血狱葬神，战力恐怖绝伦，早已触摸上古灭道之境。
魔主此举，已然是动了绝杀死手！
不惜动用帝级战力，只为踏碎桃源、掠夺烟火残璧、斩断五人正道根基、扼杀何日初生桃运、覆灭补天大业！
魔云翻涌，一道巍峨漆黑的帝影，缓步踏空而出。
其身躯万丈，立身九天魔雾之间，身披万古血狱龙鳞帝甲，甲缝流淌猩红血光，黑发乱舞虚空，双目如九幽血月，扫视苍生万物，眼底唯余寂灭无情。周身环绕无尽血色魔火、幽冥煞气、万古怨魂，每一次呼吸，都吞吐血狱浊气、湮灭天地生机。
血狱魔帝俯瞰下方渺小五人，声如九幽洪钟，震荡整片秘境，冰冷无情、蔑视苍生：
“时序四神，桃源灵女。”
“尔等逆天补天、逆主行道、助长正道气运，屡坏魔主大业，早已罪该万死。”
“魔主有谕：桃源踏碎、残璧收缴、五神诛灭、灵女献祭！今日此地，无人可活、无璧可留、无道可逃！”

话音落，血狱魔帝抬手覆天。
无边血色狱火自虚空喷涌而出，化作万丈火海，焚烧桃源结界！
“轰隆——！！！”
桃源万古先天结界剧烈震颤，整片秘境光幕裂痕密布、灵光狂泄、岌岌可危。结界之外，亿万魔兵齐声嘶吼，魔戈齐鸣、战意冲霄，只待结界破碎，便即刻涌入屠灭一切！
危机空前，绝境降临！
何年厉声大喝，声震四野，极速调度阵型：“魔帝战力超绝，不可单打独斗！即刻启五象补天镇魔大阵！五道合一、五韵同源、生死同心、死守桃源！”
此前四神四象阵法，已然固若金汤、攻防无双。今日公孙离入局，花间舞道、灵韵生机、人间温情道力补齐，五道相生、五气循环、五韵互济，阵法圆满大成！
是专门制衡魔界寂灭杀道、抗衡魔帝灭世之力的终极正道大阵！
“各守阵位！”
何年立身阵中主位，执掌时序道印，定乾坤、镇阵基、稳时序、锁虚空！莹白天篆道纹漫天铺展，稳住摇摇欲坠的秘境结界，逆转紊乱天地气机！
何月居左阵，月华万道铺展，安神渡魂、柔化杀力、抚平魔煞戾气、护住五人心神道基！银辉如水，层层叠叠，化作圆满护神光轮，隔绝魔帝寂灭意志侵蚀！
花月初居右阵，草木生机尽数爆发，灵海滔滔、青藤万锁、生生不息！以草木长生大道抗衡血狱寂灭杀道，以生克死、以繁抵灭、以绵延破终结！
何日居前阵，骄阳正道全开！金赤烈火冲天彻地、至阳正气焚尽万邪、煌煌天光劈开漫天魔雾！身为阵前杀伐利刃，正面硬撼魔帝滔天帝威，死守大阵第一道防线！
公孙离居后阵、阵眼调和之位！
纸伞撑开、舞韵流转、花间灵机漫天飞舞，以桃源千年清净道韵、人间温情生机，调和四道刚猛道力，补全阵法柔润破绽、循环五道气机、稳固大阵生生不息！
五人站位瞬息成型，五道神光冲天交融！
莹白时序、银清月华、翠绿草木、金赤骄阳、粉彩花间，五道通天光柱贯穿天地，交织成一座浩瀚璀璨、笼罩整座桃源的七彩巨阵！
content_en:
The eternal tranquility of Taoyuan was once covered with demonic smoke.
Since the remnant of the third time-sequence jade biscuit has been successfully returned to its place, and the human fireworks have completed 30% of the foundation of heaven, the righteous destiny of the three realms has risen to its peak, and the devil's fear has deepened. Finally, he did not hesitate to destroy the origin of the demon world, tear apart the eternal void barrier, and personally dispatched the ultimate combat power of his subordinates to trigger a monstrous demonic catastrophe and suppress the Taoyuan.
The sky is full of black magic clouds that are pouring down from nine days away, layer upon layer, rolling and sinking, covering the clear sky of Taoyuan, swallowing up all the gentle light of the sky. The pure land outside the world, which had just been filled with falling stars, gentle breeze, and clear lake light, was suddenly completely enveloped by the cold and desolate atmosphere.
The wind stops, the flowers become silent, the water freezes, and the clouds die.
The entire secret realm was transformed from a fairyland on earth into a killing ground for Shura in an instant.
Deep in the demon cloud, thunder is rolling, demon flames are scorching, and evil spirits are overwhelming. Billions of demon soldiers are arrayed in the void, with dense iron armor, demonic swords reflecting black light, and war energy locking the sky. The dark demon army was arranged layer by layer, boundless, like a tide covering the sky, besieging the entire secret realm tightly, leaving no way out and no way out.
A terrifying demonic power that is superior to all demons and far surpasses Demon Commander Splitting Mountain and Demon Lord Yougui slowly awakens from the deepest part of the demon cloud and slowly spreads out.
Shen, silence, desolation, ancient, hegemony, evil, destruction!
The seven-character magic rhyme overwhelmed the surrounding areas, causing the earth's veins in Taoyuan to tremble, the spiritual spring to flow backwards, the peach forest to rustle, and the barrier to buzz.
He Nian's eyes suddenly condensed, the Time Sequence Avenue was running at an extremely fast speed, the Heavenly Seal Dao patterns covered his whole body, and his expression was extremely solemn: "This is the Blood Hell Demon Emperor! The head of the four demon emperors under the Demon Lord, he is in charge of the blood prison killings and eternal annihilation. He is the ultimate existence in the demon world second only to the Demon Lord!"
As soon as the words fell to the ground, the four people were shocked.
The previous demon commanders and demon kings were all middle-level combatants in the demon world. Although they were extremely dangerous, they could still compete together. Now that the Demon Emperor has arrived in person, he is the top killing force in the Demon Realm. He has fought for eternity, slaughtered countless immortals, and buried gods in the blood prison. His combat power is terrifying and unparalleled. He has already touched the realm of destruction in ancient times.
The Demon Lord's move was already a killer move!
He did not hesitate to use emperor-level combat power, just to crush the peach garden, plunder the remaining fireworks, cut off the foundation of the five people's righteous path, kill the luck of the new born peach blossom, and destroy the great cause of mending the sky!
Demonic clouds surged, and a towering black emperor's shadow slowly stepped out of the sky.
His body is ten thousand feet long, standing in the nine-sky demonic mist. He is wearing the eternal Blood Hell Dragon Scale Emperor Armor, with scarlet blood flowing from the seams of the armor. His black hair is dancing in the sky, and his eyes are like the Nine Nether Blood Moon, scanning all living things, with only silence and ruthlessness remaining in his eyes. The whole body is surrounded by endless blood-colored demonic fire, netherworldly evil energy, and eternal resentful souls. Every time he breathes, he swallows the turbid air of blood hell and annihilates the vitality of heaven and earth.
The Blood Prison Demon Emperor looked down at the five small people below, and his sound was like a nine-nether bell, shaking the entire secret realm, cold and ruthless, and contemptuous of the common people:
"The Four Gods of Time, the Spiritual Girl of Taoyuan."
"You have gone against the will of heaven, gone against the Lord's path, promoted the good fortune, and repeatedly ruined the great cause of the Demon Lord. You have already deserved death."
"The Demon Lord has an edict: crush the peach garden to pieces, confiscate the remaining jade, destroy the five gods, and sacrifice the spirit girl! Here today, no one can live, no jade can be left, and no way can escape!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the Blood Hell Demon Emperor raised his hand to the sky.
The boundless bloody hellfire spurted out from the void, turned into a sea of ​​​​fire, and burned the Taoyuan barrier!
"Boom——!!!"
Taoyuan's eternal innate barrier trembled violently, and the entire secret realm's light curtain was filled with cracks, auras leaked wildly, and was in danger. Outside the barrier, hundreds of millions of demonic soldiers roared in unison, their demonic weapons roared, and their fighting spirit surged into the sky. As soon as the barrier was broken, they immediately rushed in to slaughter everything!
The crisis is unprecedented and desperation has arrived!
He Nian shouted loudly, his voice shook the surrounding areas, and he quickly arranged the formation: "The Demon Emperor has extraordinary combat power, and cannot fight alone! Immediately activate the five-elephant sky-repairing demon-suppressing formation! The five paths are unified, the five rhymes have the same origin, life and death are of the same mind, and we will defend the peach garden to the death!"
The previous formation of four gods and four elephants was already impregnable and unparalleled in attack and defense. Today, Gongsun Li enters the game, with the power of dance among flowers, vitality of spiritual rhyme, and warmth of human beings, the five paths are mutually reinforcing, the five qi circulate, and the five rhymes complement each other. The formation is complete!
It is specially designed to check and balance the destruction of the demon world.The ultimate righteous formation to kill and resist the demon emperor's world-destroying power!
"Everyone holds his position!"
In what year did he take the main position in the formation, take charge of the time sequence seal, determine the universe, stabilize the formation foundation, stabilize the time sequence, and lock the void! Yingtian's seal script patterns spread all over the sky, stabilizing the crumbling secret realm and reversing the chaos of heaven and earth!
He Yue is in the left formation, and the moonlight spreads out in thousands of ways, calming the gods and souls, softening the killing power, calming the demonic evil spirit, and protecting the five people's hearts, minds, and foundations! The silver glow is like water, layer upon layer, turning into a perfect protective halo of light, blocking the erosion of the Demon Emperor's will of destruction!
At the beginning of the month, the flowers are on the right, and the life of the vegetation bursts out. The spiritual sea surges, the green vines are locked, and the life is endless! Use the avenue of immortality of vegetation to counter the path of death and destruction in the Blood Hell, use life to defeat death, use complexity to resist destruction, and use continuity to break the end!
When you are in the front line, the scorching sun and the right path are fully open! The golden red fire soars into the sky and the earth, the righteousness of the sun burns away all evils, and the brilliant sky light splits the devilish mist all over the sky! As a sharp killing blade in front of the formation, he can challenge the Demon Emperor's majestic power head-on and defend the first line of defense of the formation!
Gongsun Li was in the position of reconciliation in the rear formation and the formation eye!
The paper umbrellas are opened, the dance rhythm is flowing, and the flowers are flying in the sky. With the pure Taoist charm of Taoyuan for thousands of years and the warmth and vitality of the world, the four strong Tao forces are harmonized to complement the formation's soft and smooth flaws, circulate the five qi machines, and stabilize the formation endlessly!
The positions of the five people took shape instantly, and the five divine lights soared into the sky and blended together!
White time sequence, silvery moonlight, emerald green vegetation, golden red sun, pastel flowers, five sky-reaching light pillars penetrate the sky and the earth, intertwining into a vast and bright colorful array that covers the entire Taoyuan!
